logic.note: SSD1681 command set as the libraries use it: RAM windows and counters (0x44 / 0x45 / 0x4E / 0x4F), data entry modes (0x11), the two RAMs (0x24 new, 0x26 previous), display update control (0x21 / 0x22) and master activation (0x20), deep sleep (0x10) that only a hardware reset ends. The glass changes only when a refresh finishes; a partial refresh redraws only pixels that differ between the two RAMs.

timing.note: BUSY is high for a fixed 2000 ms (full) / 500 ms (partial) / 100 ms (power on) / 150 ms (power off), GxEPD2's figures for this panel; the real times depend on temperature and the waveform (LUT).

analog.note: No grey levels, no fading, no temperature compensation, no flicker during a full refresh (the new image appears at the end).

power.note: About 8 mA while refreshing (Waveshare: 26.4 mW refresh power), 0.5 mA with the panel supplies left on, about 30 µA awake, 1 µA in deep sleep; nothing to keep the image.

emulates: The SSD1681 command and RAM model

doesNotEmulate: Grey levels and the flashing of a full refresh
Reading RAM or the temperature sensor back

testOnRealDevice: Do a full refresh every few partial ones (the panel maker recommends it) or the image degrades
Below 0 °C refreshes get slow and faint
Check the module's VCC: bare SSD1681 boards are 3.3 V only
Hibernate (0x10) after each update; check the sleep current with a µA meter
